# Vidhu P Vinod Portfolio

> Personal portfolio website of Vidhu P Vinod, engineering student, software developer, and photographer.

This site serves as a digital showcase of engineering architectures, high-fidelity interfaces, achievements, and photography.

## Technology Stack
- **Frontend Framework**: React 18 (TypeScript), Vite
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS, custom Playfair Display (serif) and Inter (sans-serif) typography
- **Routing**: React Router DOM
- **Deployment**: Netlify

## Site Map & Routes
- [Home](/) - Main landing page showcasing Selected Works, Accolades (Certifications), Philosophy, and Contact options.
- [Arcade](/arcade) - Interactive mini-game hub.
  - [Tetris](/arcade/tetris) - Custom React-based retro Tetris game.
- [Photography](/photography) - Curated geometry and lighting gallery with link to full VSCO profile.

## Selected Works
- [Insights](https://insights.mec.ac.in) - Automated student results parsing, database separation, and analytics suite. Built with PostgreSQL, FastAPI, and React. (Active deployment for MEC: 360+ unique users, 1,260+ page views).
- [The Narrative](https://the-narrative-web.vercel.app/) - meeting transcript intelligence extraction tool using LangGraph multi-agent swarm architecture.
- [Law Sahayi](https://law-sahayi.streamlit.app/) - Legal assistant AI summarizing Supreme Court judgments using Gemini AI.
- [RentEase](https://github.com/swathi-v-4002/RentEase) - Full-stack MERN application for peer-to-peer item renting.
- [Skylarks](https://github.com/aditeya24/skylarks) - ROS2-based stack for autonomous QR-code guided payload delivery drones.
